The recipes cover a wide spectrum of cuisine types, allowing you to cook something delicious for any season:

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this book suitable for beginners?**
Yes! The cookbook provides a wide variety of recipes, ranging from simple salads to more involved tarts, making it accessible whether you are an experienced cook or just starting your culinary journey.

**Do the recipes cater to different diets?**
The focus is entirely on plant-based cooking (vegetarian), ensuring meals free of meat and fish. The inclusion of various grains and legumes helps provide balanced nutrition for diverse dietary needs.
